# mtncloud_load_balancer_listener (Data Source)

Looks up one listener of a load balancer by ID or by name. Pick the load balancer by ID or name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "mtncloud_network" "app" {
  name = "app-net"
}

data "mtncloud_load_balancer_listener" "https" {
  network_id         = data.mtncloud_network.app.id
  load_balancer_name = "web-lb"
  name               = "https"
}

output "https_pool" {
  value = data.mtncloud_load_balancer_listener.https.default_pool_id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `network_id` (Number) ID of the MTN Network the load balancer is on, for example `mtncloud_network.app.id`. Your tenant must own the network or have it shared with it.

### Optional

- `id` (String) The listener's ID. Give this or `name`.
- `load_balancer_id` (String) Load balancer ID. Give this or `load_balancer_name`.
- `load_balancer_name` (String) Load balancer name, matched exactly; it must match exactly one on the network. Give this or `load_balancer_id`.
- `name` (String) The listener's name, matched exactly. Give this or `id`.

### Read-Only

- `allowed_cidrs` (List of String) Addresses allowed to connect; empty allows any.
- `client_data_timeout` (Number) Milliseconds a client connection may stay idle.
- `connection_limit` (Number) Most connections at once; `-1` for no limit.
- `default_pool_id` (String) ID of the pool it sends traffic to, or empty.
- `description` (String) Description, or empty.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether it is administratively up.
- `member_connect_timeout` (Number) Milliseconds to wait for a member to accept a connection.
- `member_data_timeout` (Number) Milliseconds a member connection may stay idle.
- `operating_status` (String) `ONLINE`, `OFFLINE`, `DEGRADED`, `ERROR` or `NO_MONITOR`.
- `port` (Number) Port it listens on.
- `protocol` (String) `HTTP`, `HTTPS`, `TERMINATED_HTTPS`, `TCP` or `UDP`.
- `provisioning_status` (String) `ACTIVE`, or `PENDING_CREATE`, `PENDING_UPDATE`, `PENDING_DELETE` while a change is applied, or `ERROR`.
- `tcp_inspect_timeout` (Number) Milliseconds to wait for more data to inspect.
- `tls_certificate_ref` (String) Reference to the certificate a `TERMINATED_HTTPS` listener uses, or empty.
